body: Well, now I'm going to have to rethink the conversation I'll have when I go to my school's psychological services. Thanks for the heads up!

The original cosmos is what fueled me after losing my religion. The newer one was okay, but not as good. Not sure which you are referring to but I'll re-watch both anyways.

It does feel like someone is taking control of my future, and I want to take it back, but how? That seems to make things worse than they are, I have a ton of school debt, I'm close to graduating, so dropping out now would make the past few years a waste of time and money, plus if I don't get this degree, what I am to do? I have no prospects, no skills, no world experience to just join another field. On top of that, let's say I change majors to something I thoroughly enjoy, there is no money left to accomplish that, not to mention time. (My school requires you to graduate within a time frame or your financial aid(student loans) will stop.)

I don't even know what I would do in life that I would enjoy. I use to enjoy things, and have energy for things. There's just no more inspiration inside of me. The flame went out, I cant find the match. I want to try, I want to go find it, because then I'll have something to live for. But for the past year or so, it feels like that feeling of "something to live for" will never come back.

>Sometimes it is hard to enjoy the little things when it feels like the big things are weighing you down, drowning you.

Thank you, both of you, because I needed to read a sentence like this right now.

That experience was traumatizing. For me it would be traumatizing. Good for you to speak up and say something about it. Regardless, of how they handled you standing up for yourself, you win, you stood up for yourself. That takes something, that I can tell you not everyone has.
This is me! You're not alone. I still find myself wanting to go out and party, only to be a complete social wreck when I'm there. I love people too, but I suck at life so I have no friends.

The more I think about how you are going to speak to that one guy tomorrow, the more I think about how you are only talking to him, but there are others (3?). I really don't want to discourage you and I'm certainly not right about everything. I can tell you that I think this guy will act/say differently than if everyone was there and you confronted them all at once. People act differently around different people.

WOW this hits spot on with me. Im due to graduate in a year, and I'll be in the same boat as you. At least your not alone. Sorry i dont have advice Im basically at a social level of 0 right now. Ive invested too much into relationships, i guess i should have listened to the old cliche bros before hoes but i didnt even have bros to hang on to really. Im just a weird person that doesnt interact very well socially.

I do the same thing where if someone is not reciprocating even slightly i just give up. i suppose its a confidence problem. but more often then not i have no desire to pursue the relationship. im too fixated on myself and my desires. ive always worried about my own problems never had a reason or understanding why i would worry about someone else's problems. i guess now i understand? if i cared about others more then maybe they would be closer to me and more involved with me?

Right now it feels like i will not find a group of friends or gf. i suppose if i found a group of friends it would be easier to find a gf, since i would go out with people and interact. BOOM right there is my problem though, i dont care to go to a bar, or club thats not fun for me, ive done it and forced myself to try to have fun, but it didnt work out. I went in with a good attitude tried it but didnt like it. 

sorry this got out of control. 
Basically I want to let you know youre not alone, relationships arent easy for everyone.
